reason: I travel a lot and forget pills at home, so a sachet I can throw in my gym bag with the capsules already counted is actually useful. The $24.99 launch price for one box is low enough to try once, and the money-back guarantee covers me.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux ($23) or Goli ($19) and those last longer. I'm paying extra for the sachet, and I'm not sure I'd keep paying it after the launch price ends.
